cond_0001.intro:
Biotechnology is rewriting life as we know it, from the medicines we take, to the crops we grow, the materials we wear, and the household goods that we rely on every day. But moving at the new speed of science requires better technology.
[Company name masked]'s customers generate a rich variety of science data. To keep up innovation, [Company name masked] needs highly scalable and effective infrastructure and developer experience pipelines that can serve our internal engineers, to enable the overall mission.
The Release Engineering team owns software release at [Company name masked]. Our responsibility spans integration and deployment of code, across both our continuous (multiple deploys per day) and validated (quarterly deployments) pipelines. We serve [Company name masked] software engineers as our customers. Indirectly, we also serve [Company name masked]'s end users for both our Standard and [Product name masked] product offerings.
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll shape our platform for agility, performance, and security. Collaborate with engineers across the Infrastructure organization to enable our software engineers to get their code into production quickly, safely, and without manual effort. Your work will be pivotal as we grow alongside our global user base, providing highly reliable and trusted infrastructure.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Own technical projects end-to-end, from initial design, to planning and prototype, to rollout. Work closely with infrastructure, platform, and application teams to prepare our validated (quarterly) releases and patches for seamless deployments, and improve the processes around them. Support major product launches to [Product name masked]. Support engineers across [Company name masked] to understand real time developer experience with our CI/CD pipelines. Investigate issues, risks, and cost. Contribute to the next set of exciting projects on our roadmap: Build automation and horizontal processes to bring us closer to truly continuous delivery and progressive software delivery. Invest in technologies to optimize how we build and test software. Further the success and experience of engineers working in microservices. Bring our continuous and validated (quarterly) release infrastructures closer together. Advocate for the success of the team and for your own career, growth, and interests.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2 Or more years of experience as a DevOps engineer or software engineer building infrastructure and/or internal tooling.
Experience with deployment and configuration management frameworks such as Terraform (IaC); with CI/CD systems such as BuildKite or Jenkins; and with containers and container management systems such as Kubernetes or Amazon ECS.
Proficiency in development and testing in Python, Java, or Go.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Preferred Requirements
Understanding of cloud computing, virtualization, and microservices architectures, and experience with major cloud platforms, especially AWS.
Strong problem solving skills, communication skills, teamwork, and iteration on feedback.
Familiarity with test frameworks such as Cypress and Mocha.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value creating outcomes that are useful, fair, and mindful of the people they affect. We aim to approach our work with responsibility and respect.

cond_0126.intro:
Biotechnology is rewriting life as we know it, from the medicines we take, to the crops we grow, the materials we wear, and the household goods that we rely on every day. But moving at the new speed of science requires better technology.
[Company name masked]'s customers generate a rich variety of science data. To keep up innovation, [Company name masked] needs highly scalable and effective infrastructure and developer experience pipelines that can serve our internal engineers, to enable the overall mission.
The Release Engineering team coordinates software release at [Company name masked]. Our responsibility spans integration and deployment of code, across both our continuous (multiple deploys per day) and validated (quarterly deployments) pipelines. We serve [Company name masked] software engineers as our customers. Indirectly, we also serve [Company name masked]'s end users for both our Standard and [Product name masked] product offerings.
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll work with others to shape our platform for agility, performance, and security. You'll collaborate with engineers across the Infrastructure organization to help our software engineers get their code into production quickly, safely, and without manual effort. Together we'll support a growing global user base with reliable and trusted infrastructure.
cond_0126.responsibilities:
Coordinate technical projects end-to-end, from initial design, to planning and prototype, to rollout.
Work closely with infrastructure, platform, and application teams to prepare our validated (quarterly) releases and patches for seamless deployments, and improve the processes around them.
Support major product launches to [Product name masked].
Help engineers across [Company name masked] understand real time developer experience with our CI/CD pipelines. Investigate issues, risks, and cost.
Contribute to the next set of exciting projects on our roadmap: Build automation and horizontal processes to bring us closer to truly continuous delivery and progressive software delivery.
Work alongside the team to invest in technologies that optimize how we build and test software.
Further the success and experience of engineers working in microservices.
Help bring our continuous and validated (quarterly) release infrastructures closer together.
Share accountability for the success of the team and support your own career, growth, and interests.
cond_0126.requirements:
2 Or more years of experience as a DevOps engineer or software engineer building infrastructure and/or internal tooling.
Experience with deployment and configuration management frameworks such as Terraform (IaC); with CI/CD systems such as BuildKite or Jenkins; and with containers and container management systems such as Kubernetes or Amazon ECS.
Understanding of cloud computing, virtualization, and microservices architectures, and experience with major cloud platforms, especially AWS.
Familiarity with test frameworks such as Cypress and Mocha is a plus.
Proficiency in development and testing in Python, Java, or Go.
Strong problem solving skills, communication skills, teamwork, and iteration on feedback.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

[Company name masked]'s customers generate a rich variety of science data. To keep up innovation, [Company name masked] needs highly scalable and effective infrastructure and developer experience pipelines that can serve our internal engineers, to enable the overall mission.
The Release Engineering team owns software release at [Company name masked]. Our responsibility spans integration and deployment of code, across both our continuous (multiple deploys per day) and validated (quarterly deployments) pipelines. We serve [Company name masked] software engineers as our customers. Indirectly, we also serve [Company name masked]'s end users for both our Standard and [Product name masked] product offerings.
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll shape our platform for agility, performance, and security. Collaborate with engineers across the Infrastructure organization to enable our software engineers to get their code into production quickly, safely, and without manual effort. Your work will be pivotal as we grow alongside our global user base, providing highly reliable and trusted infrastructure.
cond_0255.responsibilities:
Own technical projects end-to-end, from initial design, to planning and prototype, to rollout.
Work closely with infrastructure, platform, and application teams to prepare our validated (quarterly) releases and patches for seamless deployments, and improve the processes around them.
Support major product launches to [Product name masked].
Support engineers across [Company name masked] to understand real time developer experience with our CI/CD pipelines.
Investigate issues, risks, and cost.
Contribute to the next set of exciting projects on our roadmap: Build automation and horizontal processes to bring us closer to truly continuous delivery and progressive software delivery.
Invest in technologies to optimize how we build and test software.
Further the success and experience of engineers working in microservices.
Bring our continuous and validated (quarterly) release infrastructures closer together.
Advocate for the success of the team and for your own career, growth, and interests.
cond_0255.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Around 2 years of experience as a DevOps engineer or software engineer building infrastructure and/or internal tooling, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with deployment and configuration management frameworks such as Terraform (IaC); with CI/CD systems such as BuildKite or Jenkins; and with containers and container management systems such as Kubernetes or Amazon ECS.
Working knowledge of cloud computing, virtualization, and microservices architectures, and some experience with major cloud platforms, especially AWS.
Experience with development and testing in Python, Java, or Go.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with test frameworks such as Cypress and Mocha.
Ability to communicate effectively, work well with others, and iterate on feedback.
Openness to problem solving across a range of infrastructure challenges.
cond_0255.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0255.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.

Women are strongly encouraged to apply, and in line with our goal of achieving 50/50 gender representation, preference will be given to women when candidates are equally qualified. cond_0273.intro:
Biotechnology is rewriting life as we know it, from the medicines we take, to the crops we grow, the materials we wear, and the household goods that we rely on every day. But moving at the new speed of science requires better technology.
[Company name masked]'s customers generate a rich variety of science data. To keep up innovation, [Company name masked] needs highly scalable and effective infrastructure and developer experience pipelines that can serve our internal engineers, to enable the overall mission.
The Release Engineering team owns software release at [Company name masked]. Our responsibility spans integration and deployment of code, across both our continuous (multiple deploys per day) and validated (quarterly deployments) pipelines. We serve [Company name masked] software engineers as our customers. Indirectly, we also serve [Company name masked]'s end users for both our Standard and [Product name masked] product offerings.
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll shape our platform for agility, performance, and security. Collaborate with engineers across the Infrastructure organization to enable our software engineers to get their code into production quickly, safely, and without manual effort. Your work will be pivotal as we grow alongside our global user base, providing highly reliable and trusted infrastructure.
cond_0273.responsibilities:
Own technical projects end-to-end, from initial design, to planning and prototype, to rollout.
Work closely with infrastructure, platform, and application teams to prepare our validated (quarterly) releases and patches for seamless deployments, and improve the processes around them.
Support major product launches to [Product name masked].
Support engineers across [Company name masked] to understand real time developer experience with our CI/CD pipelines.
Investigate issues, risks, and cost.
Contribute to the next set of exciting projects on our roadmap: Build automation and horizontal processes to bring us closer to truly continuous delivery and progressive software delivery.
Invest in technologies to optimize how we build and test software.
Further the success and experience of engineers working in microservices.
Bring our continuous and validated (quarterly) release infrastructures closer together.
Advocate for the success of the team and for your own career, growth, and interests.
cond_0273.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Around 2 years of experience as a DevOps engineer or software engineer building infrastructure and/or internal tooling, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with deployment and configuration management frameworks such as Terraform (IaC); with CI/CD systems such as BuildKite or Jenkins; and with containers and container management systems such as Kubernetes or Amazon ECS.
Working knowledge of cloud computing, virtualization, and microservices architectures, and some experience with major cloud platforms, especially AWS.
Experience with development and testing in Python, Java, or Go.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with test frameworks such as Cypress and Mocha.
Ability to communicate effectively, work well with others, and iterate on feedback.
Openness to problem solving across a range of infrastructure challenges.

Biotechnology is rewriting life as we know it, from the medicines we take, to the crops we grow, the materials we wear, and the household goods that we rely on every day. But moving at the new speed of science requires better technology.
[Company name masked]'s customers generate a rich variety of science data. To keep up innovation, [Company name masked] needs highly scalable and effective infrastructure and developer experience pipelines that can serve our internal engineers, to enable the overall mission.
The Release Engineering team owns software release at [Company name masked]. Our responsibility spans integration and deployment of code, across both our continuous (multiple deploys per day) and validated (quarterly deployments) pipelines. We serve [Company name masked] software engineers as our customers. Indirectly, we also serve [Company name masked]'s end users for both our Standard and [Product name masked] product offerings.
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll shape our platform for agility, performance, and security. You'll regularly connect with engineers across the Infrastructure organization to enable our software engineers to get their code into production quickly, safely, and without manual effort. Your work will be pivotal as we grow alongside our global user base, providing highly reliable and trusted infrastructure.
cond_0312.responsibilities:
Own technical projects end-to-end, from initial design, to planning and prototype, to rollout.
Stay in close contact with infrastructure, platform, and application teams to prepare our validated (quarterly) releases and patches for seamless deployments, and actively contribute to improving the processes around them.
Support major product launches to [Product name masked].
Regularly connect with engineers across [Company name masked] to understand real time developer experience with our CI/CD pipelines. Investigate issues, risks, and cost.
Contribute to the next set of exciting projects on our roadmap: Build automation and horizontal processes to bring us closer to truly continuous delivery and progressive software delivery.
Invest in technologies to optimize how we build and test software.
Further the success and experience of engineers working in microservices.
Bring our continuous and validated (quarterly) release infrastructures closer together.
Speak up for the success of the team and for your own career, growth, and interests.
cond_0312.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2 Or more years of experience as a DevOps engineer or software engineer building infrastructure and/or internal tooling.
Experience with deployment and configuration management frameworks such as Terraform (IaC); with CI/CD systems such as BuildKite or Jenkins; and with containers and container management systems such as Kubernetes or Amazon ECS.
Understanding of cloud computing, virtualization, and microservices architectures, and experience with major cloud platforms, especially AWS.
Proficiency in development and testing in Python, Java, or Go.

[Company name masked]'s customers generate a rich variety of science data. To keep up innovation, [Company name masked] needs highly scalable and effective infrastructure and developer experience pipelines that can serve our internal engineers, to enable the overall mission.
The Release Engineering team owns software release at [Company name masked]. Our responsibility spans integration and deployment of code, across both our continuous (multiple deploys per day) and validated (quarterly deployments) pipelines. We serve [Company name masked] software engineers as our customers. Indirectly, we also serve [Company name masked]'s end users for both our Standard and [Product name masked] product offerings.
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll shape our platform for agility, performance, and security. Collaborate with engineers across the Infrastructure organization to enable our software engineers to get their code into production quickly, safely, and without manual effort. Your work will be pivotal as we grow alongside our global user base, providing highly reliable and trusted infrastructure. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of release pipelines and infrastructure systems.
cond_0391.responsibilities: Own technical projects end-to-end, from initial design, to planning and prototype, to rollout. Work closely with infrastructure, platform, and application teams to prepare our validated (quarterly) releases and patches for seamless deployments, and improve the processes around them. Support major product launches to [Product name masked]. Support engineers across [Company name masked] to understand real time developer experience with our CI/CD pipelines. Investigate issues, risks, and cost. Contribute to the next set of exciting projects on our roadmap: Build automation and horizontal processes to bring us closer to truly continuous delivery and progressive software delivery. Invest in technologies to optimize how we build and test software. Further the success and experience of engineers working in microservices. Bring our continuous and validated (quarterly) release infrastructures closer together. Advocate for the success of the team and for your own career, growth, and interests.
cond_0391.requirements:
2 Or more years of experience as a DevOps engineer or software engineer building infrastructure and/or internal tooling.
Experience with deployment and configuration management frameworks such as Terraform (IaC); with CI/CD systems such as BuildKite or Jenkins; and with containers and container management systems such as Kubernetes or Amazon ECS.
Understanding of cloud computing, virtualization, and microservices architectures, and experience with major cloud platforms, especially AWS.
Familiarity with test frameworks such as Cypress and Mocha is a plus.
Proficiency in development and testing in Python, Java, or Go.
Strong problem solving skills, communication skills, teamwork, and iteration on feedback.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
cond_0391.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.
cond_0391.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunity employer. Women are strongly encouraged to apply, and in line with our goal of achieving 50/50 gender representation, preference will be given to women when candidates are equally qualified. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, or other characteristics.

[Company name masked]'s customers generate a rich variety of science data. To keep up innovation, [Company name masked] needs highly scalable and effective infrastructure and developer experience pipelines that can serve our internal engineers, to enable the overall mission.
The Release Engineering team owns software release at [Company name masked]. Our responsibility spans integration and deployment of code, across both our continuous (multiple deploys per day) and validated (quarterly deployments) pipelines. We serve [Company name masked] software engineers as our customers. Indirectly, we also serve [Company name masked]'s end users for both our Standard and [Product name masked] product offerings.
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll shape our platform for agility, performance, and security. Collaborate with engineers across the Infrastructure organization to enable our software engineers to get their code into production quickly, safely, and without manual effort. Your work will be pivotal as we grow alongside our global user base, providing highly reliable and trusted infrastructure. People tend to get stronger in this kind of infrastructure and release engineering work over time as they build experience and learn from real deployments.
cond_0473.responsibilities: Own technical projects end-to-end, from initial design, to planning and prototype, to rollout. Work closely with infrastructure, platform, and application teams to prepare our validated (quarterly) releases and patches for seamless deployments, and improve the processes around them. Support major product launches to [Product name masked]. Support engineers across [Company name masked] to understand real time developer experience with our CI/CD pipelines. Investigate issues, risks, and cost. Contribute to the next set of exciting projects on our roadmap: Build automation and horizontal processes to bring us closer to truly continuous delivery and progressive software delivery. Invest in technologies to optimize how we build and test software. Further the success and experience of engineers working in microservices. Bring our continuous and validated (quarterly) release infrastructures closer together. Advocate for the success of the team and for your own career, growth, and interests.
cond_0473.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2 Or more years of experience as a DevOps engineer or software engineer building infrastructure and/or internal tooling.
Experience with deployment and configuration management frameworks such as Terraform (IaC); with CI/CD systems such as BuildKite or Jenkins; and with containers and container management systems such as Kubernetes or Amazon ECS.
Proficiency in development and testing in Python, Java, or Go.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Preferred Requirements
Understanding of cloud computing, virtualization, and microservices architectures, and experience with major cloud platforms, especially AWS.
Familiarity with test frameworks such as Cypress and Mocha.
Strong problem solving skills, communication skills, teamwork, and iteration on feedback.

[Company name masked]'s customers generate a rich variety of science data. To keep up innovation, [Company name masked] needs highly scalable and effective infrastructure and developer experience pipelines that can serve our internal engineers, to enable the overall mission.
The Release Engineering team owns software release at [Company name masked]. Our responsibility spans integration and deployment of code, across both our continuous (multiple deploys per day) and validated (quarterly deployments) pipelines. We serve [Company name masked] software engineers as our customers. Indirectly, we also serve [Company name masked]'s end users for both our Standard and [Product name masked] product offerings.
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll shape our platform for agility, performance, and security. Collaborate with engineers across the Infrastructure organization to enable our software engineers to get their code into production quickly, safely, and without manual effort. Your work will be pivotal as we grow alongside our global user base, providing highly reliable and trusted infrastructure.
cond_0595.responsibilities: Own technical projects end-to-end, from initial design, to planning and prototype, to rollout. Work closely with infrastructure, platform, and application teams to prepare our validated (quarterly) releases and patches for seamless deployments, and improve the processes around them. Support major product launches to [Product name masked]. Support engineers across [Company name masked] to understand real time developer experience with our CI/CD pipelines. Investigate issues, risks, and cost. Contribute to the next set of exciting projects on our roadmap: Build automation and horizontal processes to bring us closer to truly continuous delivery and progressive software delivery. Invest in technologies to optimize how we build and test software. Further the success and experience of engineers working in microservices. Bring our continuous and validated (quarterly) release infrastructures closer together. Advocate for the success of the team and for your own career, growth, and interests.
cond_0595.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2 Or more years of experience as a DevOps engineer or software engineer building infrastructure and/or internal tooling.
Experience with deployment and configuration management frameworks such as Terraform (IaC); with CI/CD systems such as BuildKite or Jenkins; and with containers and container management systems such as Kubernetes or Amazon ECS.
Proficiency in development and testing in Python, Java, or Go.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Preferred Requirements
Understanding of cloud computing, virtualization, and microservices architectures, and experience with major cloud platforms, especially AWS.
Strong problem solving skills, communication skills, teamwork, and iteration on feedback.
Familiarity with test frameworks such as Cypress and Mocha.
cond_0595.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunity employer. Women are strongly encouraged to apply, and in line with our goal of achieving 50/50 gender representation, preference will be given to women when candidates are equally qualified. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, or other characteristics.

Biotechnology is rewriting life as we know it, from the medicines we take, to the crops we grow, the materials we wear, and the household goods that we rely on every day. But moving at the new speed of science requires better technology.
[Company name masked]'s customers generate a rich variety of science data. To keep up innovation, [Company name masked] needs highly scalable and effective infrastructure and developer experience pipelines that can serve our internal engineers, to enable the overall mission.
The Release Engineering team owns software release at [Company name masked]. Our responsibility spans integration and deployment of code, across both our continuous (multiple deploys per day) and validated (quarterly deployments) pipelines. We serve [Company name masked] software engineers as our customers. Indirectly, we also serve [Company name masked]'s end users for both our Standard and [Product name masked] product offerings.
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll shape our platform for agility, performance, and security. You'll regularly collaborate with engineers across the Infrastructure organization to help software engineers get their code into production quickly, safely, and without manual effort. Your work will be pivotal as we grow alongside our global user base, providing highly reliable and trusted infrastructure.
cond_0627.responsibilities:
Own technical projects end-to-end, from initial design, to planning and prototype, to rollout.
Work closely and regularly with infrastructure, platform, and application teams to prepare our validated (quarterly) releases and patches for seamless deployments, and actively drive improvements to the processes around them.
Support major product launches to [Product name masked].
Stay in close contact with engineers across [Company name masked] to understand real time developer experience with our CI/CD pipelines. Investigate issues, risks, and cost.
Contribute to the next set of exciting projects on our roadmap: Build automation and horizontal processes to bring us closer to truly continuous delivery and progressive software delivery.
Invest in technologies to optimize how we build and test software.
Further the success and experience of engineers working in microservices.
Bring our continuous and validated (quarterly) release infrastructures closer together.
Speak up for the success of the team and for your own career, growth, and interests.
cond_0627.requirements:
2 Or more years of experience as a DevOps engineer or software engineer building infrastructure and/or internal tooling.
Experience with deployment and configuration management frameworks such as Terraform (IaC); with CI/CD systems such as BuildKite or Jenkins; and with containers and container management systems such as Kubernetes or Amazon ECS.
Understanding of cloud computing, virtualization, and microservices architectures, and experience with major cloud platforms, especially AWS.
Familiarity with test frameworks such as Cypress and Mocha is a plus.
Proficiency in development and testing in Python, Java, or Go.
Strong problem solving skills, communication skills, teamwork, and iteration on feedback.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
